title: AI-Powered Network O&M, Ensuring Uninterrupted Network During Power Rationing
summary: MTN attributes lower packet loss and delay to AI-assisted operations combined with network-routing changes, without isolating the model’s contribution.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: A transformer telecom model supports diagnosis, natural-language queries, and optimization recommendations within a system that also uses conventional network maps and routing methods. The source reports lower packet loss and delay at MTN, without separating the AI contribution or giving an effect size. The body describes deployment while the summary calls the setting an internal testbed. The claim concerns the combined AI-assisted system.
purpose: Use model-assisted diagnosis and recommendations to improve network operation during power rationing.
system: AI-Powered Network O&M, Ensuring Uninterrupted Network During Power Rationing

ratings.reason: The source attributes lower packet loss and delay to the combined AI-assisted operational system. AI supports diagnosis and recommendations, but its share of the improvement is not separately measured.
Better user experience from the AI-assisted system is asserted without a specific personal outcome sufficient to determine depth.
Wider connectivity inclusion through improved service remains intended and is not established by the operational claim.

ai_role.statement: A 38-billion-parameter transformer supports diagnosis, natural-language-to-SQL analysis, and operational recommendations alongside conventional routing.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 14: AI-Powered Network O&M, Ensuring Uninterrupted Network During Power Rationing

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: AI-assisted MTN operations report better network performance

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
